standard.name: ASTM E1001
standard.title: Detection and Evaluation of Discontinuities by the Immersed Pulse-Echo Ultrasonic Method Using Longitudinal Waves

scope.method: Immersed pulse-echo longitudinal-wave UT using one search unit as transmitter and receiver.
scope.coverage: General requirements for detecting discontinuities and relative or approximate sizing.
scope.exclusions: Does not define acceptance criteria; reporting and acceptance are contractual.

equipment.minimumEchoCapability: At least 60 percent full scale from the specified reference reflector at part thickness; noise not greater than 20 percent.
equipment.searchUnits: Immersion straight-beam longitudinal search units with flat or focused acoustic lenses.
equipment.alarm: Audible alarm preferred for regular shapes and parallel surfaces unless recording equipment is used.
equipment.manipulation: Manipulator supports angular adjustment and smooth, accurate positioning with agreed backlash limits.

referenceStandards.materialSimilarity: Attenuation, noise, surface condition, and velocity should be similar to examined material.
referenceStandards.flatBlocks: ASTM E127 area-amplitude, distance-amplitude, or combined sets may be used where empirically valid.
referenceStandards.curvedSurfaces: For radii under about 8 in / 203 mm, reference blocks must be within 10 percent of the part radius.

examinationRequirements.materialCondition: Surfaces must permit uniform examination; smooth rough areas when roughness prevents required detection and evaluation.
examinationRequirements.coverage: Scan index must be less than effective beam length at any depth and must support repeatable response from required discontinuity length.
examinationRequirements.resolution: If entry-surface resolution or one-side penetration is insufficient, examine from the opposite side.
examinationRequirements.frequencySelection: Higher frequencies improve beam directivity and resolution; lower frequencies improve penetration and detection of misaligned planar discontinuities.

setupAndStandardization.couplant: Clean, deaerated liquid couplant; corrosion inhibitors and wetting agents permitted if they do not affect material properties.

referenceBlockSelection.nearField: Use metal path increments from Table 2 with adjacent spacing limits from Table 3.
referenceBlockSelection.farField: Use at least three blocks: front-surface resolution, about half thickness, and thickness or greater.
referenceBlockSelection.combinedNearFar: Include near-field range blocks plus one block at thickness or greater.

setupAndStandardization.beamNormalization: Maximize front-surface echo; re-angle by zone if monitored front/back signal falls by more than 50 percent due to part shape.
setupAndStandardization.waterPath: Second front-surface echo must not appear before first back-surface echo; focused transducer focus should be in material at required depth.
setupAndStandardization.scanIndex: Use the least effective beam diameter measured across selected reference targets as maximum allowable scan index.
setupAndStandardization.distanceAmplitudeCurve: Set largest reference indication to 80 to 90 percent of upper linear limit and plot all selected reference block amplitudes.
setupAndStandardization.scanningGain: Set lowest point reference to 80 to 90 percent upper linear limit; +6 dB recommended for manual scanning without changing alarm level.
setupAndStandardization.alarmLevel: Trigger at 50 percent of rejection limit at equivalent metal distance.

evaluation.initialRecordingLevel: Evaluate locations above one half of reference response at equivalent depth or those triggering alarm.
evaluation.backReflection: Record locations where back-surface reflection is below specified value and verify loss is not due to roughness or nonparallel surfaces.
evaluation.singleDiscontinuity: Compare with reference reflector at equivalent depth; dynamic evaluation may be used when specified.
evaluation.multipleOrLinear: Evaluate spacing and length as agreed in the contractual procedure.

systemPerformanceChecks: After non-repeatable electrical or mechanical control adjustment
qualityAssurance.wettingAgentControl: Check corrosion inhibitor and wetting agent concentration after initial makeup and at manufacturer-recommended intervals.
